added.member: UI: CSS pointer-events, touch-action, visibility and every cursor keyword in documents
added.summary: pointer-events none and auto (inherited) and the SVG values on inline SVG shapes, tested on their fill and stroke; touch-action pans and pinch-zoom intersected down the tree; visibility hidden and collapse with visible children inside a hidden parent; cursor takes every CSS UI 4 keyword, and og.ui.Cursor gains contextMenu, cell, verticalText, alias, copy, noDrop, allScroll, resizeCol, resizeRow and the edge and corner resizes. The visible attribute stays.
